usageNotes: Use this to register a new SMTP notification endpoint in the cluster-wide notification system, which can then be referenced by notification matchers to route alerts via email. The caller must hold Mapping.Modify on /mapping/notifications plus either Sys.Modify or Sys.AccessNetwork on /. At least one of `mailto` or `mailto-user` should be provided alongside the three required fields (name, server, from-address), otherwise the endpoint is valid but will silently deliver to no one.

examples.summary: Create a TLS SMTP endpoint using a transactional mail service (e.g., SendGrid) with two alert recipients

tips: The `name` field uses pve-configid format: lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens only, no spaces.
Port defaults are applied automatically (465 for tls, 587 for starttls, 25 for insecure) — omit `port` unless overriding.
An endpoint created with `disable: true` is stored but ignored by matchers until re-enabled via the PUT endpoint.
Passwords are write-only in the API; a subsequent GET will not return the stored credential.
`mailto-user` accepts Proxmox user IDs (e.g., root@pam) and resolves their configured email at send time, so it stays accurate if the user's address changes.
After creation, wire the endpoint into a notification matcher using the notification matcher POST/PUT endpoints so it actually receives alerts.
